items.source: Will simply return false if the supposed aspect is invalid (such as an extension of a concrete aspect class). Will return true for some aspects that Spring AOP cannot process, such as those with unsupported instantiation models. Use the AspectJAdvisorFactory.validate(Class) method to handle these cases if necessary.
items.translation: 如果所谓的切面无效（例如是具体切面类的扩展），将简单地返回 `false`。对于 Spring AOP 无法处理的一些切面，也将返回 `true`，例如那些具有不支持的实例化模型的切面。如有必要，请使用 AspectJAdvisorFactory.validate(Class) 方法来处理这些情况。

items.source:
This class handles annotation parsing and validation functionality.
It does not actually generate Spring AOP Advisors, which is deferred to subclasses.
items.translation: 该类负责处理注解解析和验证功能。它实际上不生成 Spring AOP Advisor，该操作已推迟到子类中执行。

items.source:
The default is "false". Consider switching this to "true" if you
encounter double execution of your aspects in a given build setup.
Note that we recommend restructuring your AspectJ configuration to
avoid such double exposure of an AspectJ aspect to begin with.
items.translation: 默认值为 "false"。如果您在某个构建设置中遇到织入方面（aspect）重复执行的问题，请考虑将其切换为 "true"。请注意，我们建议您重新调整 AspectJ 配置，以避免一开始就出现 AspectJ 织入方面的双重暴露问题。

items.source:
System property that instructs Spring to ignore ajc-compiled aspects
for Spring AOP proxying, restoring traditional Spring behavior for
scenarios where both weaving and AspectJ auto-proxying are enabled.
items.translation: 指示 Spring 忽略由 ajc 编译的切面以进行 Spring AOP 代理的系统属性，从而在同时启用织入和 AspectJ 自动代理的场景中恢复传统的 Spring 行为。
